selected_formula.name: alpha158_session_peer_rank_extremity_breadth_1d
selected_formula.formula: For each accepted session t and Alpha158 coordinate j, take only rows with model_support_eligible=true and finite x_tij. Let n_tj be their count and r_tij the ascending average-tie rank. Set u_tij=(r_tij-0.5)/n_tj and e_tij=2*abs(u_tij-0.5). For every quality_listing_eligible row with model_support_eligible=true and at least 119 finite coordinates, score the equal-weight arithmetic mean of e_tij over its finite coordinates. Do not use another session, fill, clip, smooth, sign, threshold, weight, fit, invert or combine the score.
selected_formula.economic_hypothesis: Broad peer-relative technical displacement across many Alpha158 coordinates may identify idiosyncratic information or positioning states that remain salient from the next open through the third close.

mechanism_separation.campaign290: No prior session, transition, suspension bridge, lagged state or persistence count is used.
mechanism_separation.campaign291: No binary below/equal/above median states or above-minus-below count imbalance is used; each coordinate retains continuous centered empirical-rank distance.
mechanism_separation.campaign103: No day-over-day directional improvement vote over the historical numeric library is used; Campaign292 is a same-session continuous displacement score over the frozen 158-coordinate Alpha158 matrix.
